description: Overcome fear of mirrors in one peaceful Zoom session. No trance, no exposure, no long-term therapy.
heroTag: Stop letting a fear of mirrors shrink your world
heroH1: Look in the mirror. Calm and free. Finally.
heroP: One peaceful Zoom session. No trance. No reliving trauma. No long-term therapy — a calmer, freer you on your terms.
problemH2: Don’t let a fear of mirrors shrink your world
problemP: Rooms and dark windows avoided — a fear few people understand. The villain is not you. It is a misfiring subconscious program — once meant to protect you, now firing indiscriminately.
quote: You are someone who looks without fear. That person already exists inside you.
externalH3: The glass, the reflection, the room
internalP: Hard to explain a fear others call strange.
deeperH3: A world fenced by one fear
deeperP: Spaces avoided. Routines twisted. Ease you stopped having at home.
reliefP: By the end of your session you will feel your world shift. Look. Stay present. Feel free.
cost3P: If looking away hasn’t fixed it, it won’t tomorrow either.
ctaH2: Your next free glance is one session away
